description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You would take damage from a Strike or effect while wielding a firearm.

The weapon takes the hit that was meant for you, and it does not fully recover from it.

Reduce the damage by an amount equal to twice your level. The firearm takes a permanent −1 penalty as though it had suffered a Cracked Barrel, cumulative with any it already has, repairable only at a proper workshop. A Good Gun may absorb this, and doing so is the only way one is ever damaged.

cinderfall.incomplete: (Cracked Barrel is a homebrew weapon-condition stack). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
